jobs.program: NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program — Summer Clerkships 2027/28 (scheme-wide dates for all participating NSW employers)
jobs.notes: Scheme confirms applications open 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 with offers from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027, but the scheme sets two permitted closing dates (Sun 4 July or Sun 11 July 2027, 11:59pm) chosen by each participating firm, so a single close date cannot be confirmed; eligibility is penultimate (and at some firms final) year students.
Currently open on the firm's own graduate careers site with a stated close of Monday 2 November 2026; the original opening date is not published on the page so it is left null.

jobs.notes: The firm's careers page confirms a future opening in March 2027 for the May 2027 program but gives only the month, so no exact open or close date can be confirmed.

The firm's early careers page states applications are currently closed and will reopen in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but only the month is given and state-by-state dates follow each Law Society scheme, so exact dates are unconfirmed.
